purpose: One admitted scalar magic send selects inherited __call, then private static body; maker retires before deferred body and Child public body is wrong.
source:
<?php
class Base84 {
    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) {
        echo 'MAKE|', $name === 'open', '|', $arguments === [84], '|',
             __CLASS__ === 'Base84', '|', static::class === 'Child84', '|';
        return self::body();
    }
    private static function body() {
        echo 'BODY|', __CLASS__ === 'Base84', '|', static::class === 'Child84', '|';
        try { yield 84; }
        finally { echo 'FIN|'; }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'MAKER|'; }
}
class Child84 extends Base84 {
    public static function body() { echo 'BAD-TARGET|'; yield 0; }
}
$maker = new Child84();
$weak = WeakReference::create($maker);
$g = $maker->open(84);
unset($maker);
echo 'FRESH|', $weak->get() === null, '|';
echo 'VALUE|', $g->current() === 84, '|';
unset($g, $weak);
echo 'E';

        return self::body($arguments[0]);

    protected function body($value) {
        global $weak;

             $this === $weak->get(), '|', $value === 84, '|';
        try { yield $value; }
        finally { echo 'FIN|', $weak->get() instanceof Child84B, '|'; }

}

$weak = WeakReference::create($maker);

purpose: Static magic factory receives an object from a real callback; Gen parameter keeps it until natural completion, and it dies while the closed Gen/return remain live.
source:
<?php
class Payload84C {
    public function __destruct() { echo 'ARG|'; }
}
function NewPayload84C() {
    global $weak;
    $payload = new Payload84C();
    $weak = WeakReference::create($payload);
    return $payload;
}
class Base84C {
    public static function __callStatic(string $name, array $arguments) {
        global $weak;
        echo 'MAKE|', $name === 'open', '|', __CLASS__ === 'Base84C', '|',
             static::class === 'Child84C', '|', $arguments[0] === $weak->get(), '|';
        return self::body($arguments[0]);
    }
    private static function body($payload) {
        global $weak;
        echo 'BODY|', __CLASS__ === 'Base84C', '|', static::class === 'Child84C', '|',
             $payload === $weak->get(), '|';
        try { yield 84; return 85; }
        finally { echo 'FIN|', $weak->get() instanceof Payload84C, '|'; }
    }
}
class Child84C extends Base84C {
    public static function body($payload) { echo 'BAD-TARGET|'; yield 0; }
}
$g = Child84C::open(NewPayload84C());
echo 'FRESH|', $weak->get() instanceof Payload84C, '|';
echo 'VALUE|', $g->current() === 84, '|';
$g->next();
echo 'AFTER|', $weak->get() === null, '|', 'RETURN|', $g->getReturn() === 85, '|';
unset($g, $weak);
echo 'E';

purpose: Argument callback overwrites the original receiver CV; selected old maker survives dispatch then retires, and later Gen body must retain old called/private target rather than reread new receiver.

<?php
class Base84D {
    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) {
        global $weakOld;
        echo 'MAKE|', $name === 'open', '|', $arguments[0] === 84, '|',
             __CLASS__ === 'Base84D', '|', static::class === 'Old84D', '|', $this === $weakOld->get(), '|';
        return self::body();
    }
    private static function body() {
        echo 'BODY|', __CLASS__ === 'Base84D', '|', static::class === 'Old84D', '|';
        try { yield 84; }
        finally { echo 'FIN|'; }
    }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'OLD|'; }
}
class Old84D extends Base84D {
    public static function body() { echo 'BAD-TARGET|'; yield 0; }
}
class Other84D {
    public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { echo 'BAD-NEW|'; return []; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'NEW|'; }
}
function Replace84D() {
    global $maker, $weakOld;
    echo 'REPLACE|', $weakOld->get() instanceof Old84D, '|';
    $maker = new Other84D();
    echo 'SELECTED|', $weakOld->get() instanceof Old84D, '|';
    return 84;
}
$maker = new Old84D();
$weakOld = WeakReference::create($maker);
$g = $maker->open(Replace84D());
echo 'FRESH|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|', $maker instanceof Other84D, '|';
echo 'VALUE|', $g->current() === 84, '|';
unset($g);
unset($maker, $weakOld);
echo 'E';
